rule.status: post-hoc development round designed on 13 Oct 2026 after the v4 test results were known; validation-only selection; test sealed until the lock; exploratory; LAST round (no v6)

riemann.windows: every valid 4 s window (32 x 1000 at 250 Hz) of the minimally pre-processed arrays, channels centred over time
riemann.rm_tslr: tangent space (log map, upper triangle, off-diagonal x sqrt 2) at the Riemannian mean of 2000 seeded training windows
riemann.rm_rctslr: each subject re-centred by its own Riemannian mean over all its valid windows (label-free), tangent space at identity
riemann.training_windows: training subjects only; at most 40 windows per training recording, seeded
riemann.prediction: recording probability = mean of window probabilities; baseline decision = argmax (no score centring)

augmentation.source: braindecode default parameters (not tuned); Rommel et al. 2022
augmentation.where: training batches only, after EA, seeded per fold

test_time_im.loss: mean per-window entropy minus entropy of the mean prediction (information maximisation; SHOT 2020, T-TIME 2023)
test_time_im.order: AdaBN on the subject's windows, then IM on the same windows, then prediction; every subject separately; no labels

v5_all.name: v4 + augmentation + test-time IM + Riemannian fusion

rule.fusion: p = normalised exp(0.5 log p_deep + 0.5 log p_riemann), per recording
rule.selection_rule: score = mean over the two datasets of the fold-mean VALIDATION balanced accuracy (seed 0), each dataset with its test-time option (none / center) chosen on validation. v5 = the candidate with the highest score, and it replaces v4 only if its score is higher than v4's score computed the same way; otherwise v5 = v4 (no change). Ties -> the simpler candidate (v5_fus, v5_im, v5_aug, v5_all).

tests.H-V5: v5 (3-seed) > v4 (3-seed), one-sided Wilcoxon over held-out subjects, Holm over the 2 datasets
tests.H-V5-tricks: v5 (3-seed) > EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] (3-seed), one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the 2 datasets
tests.H-V5-best: v5 (3-seed) > the best other model of the benchmark on that dataset (highest fold mean among FINAL, DEV_v4 and the Riemannian baselines), one-sided Wilcoxon, Holm over the 2 datasets
tests.best-model rule: v5 is called 'best' on a dataset only if its fold mean is the highest of all models AND H-V5-best is met there
tests.Riemannian baselines: reported in the table; compared descriptively (two-sided) with EEGNet, EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] and v4
